Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ هَذَيْنِ آيَتَانِ مِنْ آيَاتِكَ
Translation: O Allah, these two are signs from Your signs
And these two are assistants from Your assistants

Arabic text: يَبْتَدِرَانِ طَاعَتَكَ بِرَحْمَةٍ نَافِعَةٍ أَوْ نَقِمَةٍ ضَارَّةٍ
Translation: They hasten to obey You with beneficial mercy or harmful vengeance
So do not rain upon us through them an evil rain

Arabic text: وَ لَا تُلْبِسْنَا بِهِمَا لِبَاسَ الْبَلَاءِ
Translation: And do not clothe us through them with the garment of affliction
Send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَ أَنْزِلْ عَلَيْنَا نَفْعَ هَذِهِ السَّحَائِبِ وَ بَرَكَتَهَا
Translation: And send down upon us the benefit of these clouds and their blessings

Arabic text: وَ اصْرِفْ عَنَّا أَذَاهَا وَ مَضَرَّتَهَا
Translation: And turn away from us their harm and damage
And do not afflict us in them with calamity

Arabic text: وَ لَا تُرْسِلْ عَلَى مَعَايِشِنَا عَاهَةً
Translation: And do not send upon our livelihoods any blight

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ وَ إِنْ كُنْتَ بَعَثْتَهَا نِقْمَةً وَ أَرْسَلْتَهَا سَخْطَةً
Translation: O Allah, if You have sent them as vengeance and dispatched them in anger
Then we seek protection from Your wrath

Arabic text: وَ نَبْتَهِلُ إِلَيْكَ فِيْ سُؤَالِ عَفْوِكَ
Translation: And we implore You in asking for Your pardon
So direct Your wrath towards the polytheists

Arabic text: وَ أَدِرْ رَحَى نَقِمَتِكَ عَلَى الْمُلْحِدِيْنَ
Translation: And turn the millstone of Your vengeance upon the atheists
O Allah, remove the drought from our lands with Your watering
And expel the burning in our hearts with Your provision
And do not preoccupy us from You with other than You

Arabic text: وَ لَا تَقْطَعْ عَنْ كَافَّتِنَا مَادَّةَ بِرِّكَ
Translation: And do not cut off from all of us the resource of Your goodness
For the rich is the one whom You enrich
And the safe is the one whom You protect
No one has any defense apart from You

Arabic text: وَ لَا بِأَحَدٍ عَنْ سَطْوَتِكَ امْتِنَاعٌ
Translation: And no one has any protection from Your power

Arabic text: تَحْكُمُ بِمَا شِئْتَ عَلَى مَنْ شِئْتَ
Translation: You judge as You wish upon whom You wish

Arabic text: وَ تَقْضِيْ بِمَا أَرَدْتَ فِيمَنْ أَرَدْتَ
Translation: And You decree what You intend for whom You intend

Arabic text: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى مَا وَقَيْتَنَا مِنَ الْبَلَاءِ
Translation: So to You is praise for what You have protected us from affliction

Arabic text: وَ لَكَ الشُّكْرُ عَلَى مَا خَوَّلْتَنَا مِنَ النَّعْمَاءِ
Translation: And to You is gratitude for what You have granted us of blessings
Praise that surpasses the praise of all who praise
Praise that fills His earth and His heaven
Indeed, You are the Bestower of great favors
The Granter of magnificent blessings
The Acceptor of little praise
The Appreciator of little thanks
The Beneficent, the Beautiful, the Possessor of bounty

Arabic text: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ إِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
Translation: There is no god but You, to You is the final return
